orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）

segments.en:
Ahura Mazda spake unto Spitama Zarathushtra, saying: 'I,
Ahura Mazda, the Maker of all good things, when I made this
mansion, the beautiful, the shining, seen afar (there may I go
up, there may I arrive!)
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達對斯皮塔瑪查拉圖斯特拉說：「我阿胡拉‧馬茲達，萬般美好的造主，當我造就此宅邸，美麗者、光耀者、遠望可見者（願我上升，願我抵達！）

segments.orig:
âat mãm mairyô âkasat
âat mãm mairyô frâkerenaot
angrô mainyush pouru-mahrkô navaca ýaskê
navaitishca navaca sata navaca hazangra navasêsca baêvãn
âat mãm tûm bishazyôish mãthrô
speñtô ýô ash-hvarenå.
segments.en:
'Then the ruffian looked at me; the ruffian Angra Mainyu,
the deadly, wrought against me nine diseases, and ninety, and
nine hundred, and nine thousand, and nine times ten thousand
diseases. So mayst thou heal me, thou most glorious Manthra
Spenta!
segments.zh: 『爾時惡棍瞪視於我；惡棍安格拉‧曼紐，致死者，對我施九種疾病，九十種疾病，九百種疾病，九千種疾病，九萬種疾病。故爾應醫我，最光耀的曼特拉‧斯彭塔啊！」

segments.orig:
dathâni tê aêtahe paiti hakat hazangrem
aspanãm aurvatô derezi-takanãm ýazâi
saoka vanguhi mazdadhâta ashaoni, dathâni tê
aêtahe paiti hakat hazangrem ushtranãm urvatô

ashaoni.
segments.en:
'Unto thee will I give in return a thousand fleet,
swift-running steeds; I offer thee up a sacrifice, O good Saoka,
made by Mazda and holy.
'Unto thee will I give in return a thousand fleet,
high-humped camels; I offer thee up a sacrifice, O good Saoka,
made by Mazda and holy.
segments.zh:
『我將以千匹快捷、善跑之馬報予爾；我獻祭於爾，善哉薩歐卡，由馬茲達造、持阿沙之聖者。
我將以千匹快捷、高峰駝報予爾；我獻祭於爾，善哉薩歐卡，由馬茲達造、持阿沙之聖者。」

segments.orig:

gavãm axshaênanãm aperetô-tanunãm

tê aêtahe paiti hakat hazangrem anumayanãm
haretô vîspô-gaonanãm ýazâi
saoka vanguhi mazdadhâta ashaoni.
segments.en:
'Unto thee will I give in return a thousand brown oxen that
do not push; I offer thee up a sacrifice, O good Saoka, made by
Mazda and holy.
'Unto thee will I give in return a thousand females big with
young, of all species of small cattle; I offer thee up a
sacrifice, O good Saoka, made by Mazda and holy.
segments.zh:
『我將以千頭褐色、不觸牴之牛報予爾；我獻祭於爾，善哉薩歐卡，由馬茲達造、持阿沙之聖者。
我將以千頭懷孕、諸小家畜之牝獸報予爾；我獻祭於爾，善哉薩歐卡，由馬茲達造、持阿沙之聖者。」

segments.orig:

segments.en:
'And I will bless thee with the fair blessing-spell of the
righteous, the friendly blessing-spell of the righteous, that
makes the empty swell to fulness and the full to overflowing,
that comes to help him who was sickening, and makes the sick man
sound again.
segments.zh: 『且我將以義人之美善祝禱、義人之友善祝禱祝福爾，此祝禱使空者充滿，使滿者洋溢，來扶助彼病者，使病人復康。」

segments.orig:
paiti ahmâi avashata
mãthrô speñtô ýô ash-hvarenå,
kutha tê azem bishazâni kutha tê azem apa-varâni
navaca ýaskê navaitishca navaca sata navaca hazangra
navasêsca baêvãn.
segments.en:
'Manthra Spenta, the all-glorious, replied unto me: "How
shall I heal thee? How shall I drive away from thee those nine
diseases, and those ninety, those nine hundred, those nine
thousand, and those nine times ten thousand diseases?"'
 
 II.
segments.zh:
『曼特拉‧斯彭塔，全光耀者，答我曰：「我當如何醫爾？我當如何驅離爾之彼九種疾病、彼九十種疾病、彼九百種疾病、彼九千種疾病、彼九萬種疾病？」』

第二部

Nairyo-sangha: Go thou, Nairyo-sangha, the herald, and drive

'I, Ahura Mazda, the Maker of all good things, when I made

segments.zh: 「阿胡拉‧馬茲達，持阿沙的聖者，如此對爾言：『我阿胡拉‧馬茲達，萬般美好的造主，當我造就此宅邸，美麗者、光耀者、遠望可見者（願我上升，願我抵達！）」

segments.en:
'Then the ruffian looked at me; the ruffian Angra Mainyu,

segments.zh: 「那時惡棍看著我；惡棍安格拉‧曼紐，致命的，對我施加了九種疾病，九十種，九百種，九千種，九萬種疾病。因此，願你治癒我，啊艾里曼，履行誓願者！」

segments.en:
'Unto thee will I give in return a thousand fleet,
swift-running steeds; I offer thee up a sacrifice, O good Saoka,
made by Mazda and holy,
'Unto thee will I give in return a thousand fleet,
high-humped camels; I offer thee up a sacrifice, O good Saoka,
made by Mazda and holy,
'Unto thee will I give in return a thousand brown oxen that
do not push; I offer thee up a sacrifice, O good Saoka, made by

'Unto thee will I give in return a thousand females big with
young, of all species of small cattle. I offer thee up a
sacrifice, O good Saoka, made by Mazda and holy.
'And I will bless thee with the fair blessing-spell of the
righteous, the friendly blessing-spell of the righteous, that
make, the empty swell to fulness and the full to overflowing,
that comes to help him who was sickening, and makes the sick man
sound again.'
 
 III.
segments.zh:
「我將回贈於你一千匹迅疾、奔馳的駿馬；我向你獻祭，善良的紹卡啊，由馬茲達所造、至聖的。」
「我將回贈於你一千匹迅疾、高駝峰的駱駝；我向你獻祭，善良的紹卡啊，由馬茲達所造、至聖的。」
「我將回贈於你一千頭褐色、不頂撞的牛；我向你獻祭，善良的紹卡啊，由馬茲達所造、至聖的。」
「我將回贈於你一千頭懷孕的母畜，來自所有小牲畜的種類。我向你獻祭，善良的紹卡啊，由馬茲達所造、至聖的。」
「而我將以正義者的美善祝福、正義者的友善祝福來祝福你，那使空虛而盈滿、使充盈而溢流，來幫助病弱者、使患病者恢復健康的祝福。」

segments.en:
In obedience to Ahura's words he went, Nairyo-sangha, the
herald; he drove towards the mansion of Airyaman, he spake unto

segments.zh: 遵照阿胡拉的言語，傳令官奈里歐-桑哈前往；他駕馬奔向艾里亞曼的寓所，他對艾里亞曼說道，言語如下：

'Then the ruffian looked at me; the ruffian Angra Mainyu,

nine hundred, and nine thousand, and nine times ten thousand

'Unto thee will I give in return a thousand fleet,
swift-running steeds ; I offer thee up a sacrifice, O good Saoka,
made by Mazda and holy.
'Unto thee will I give in return a thousand fleet,
high-humped camels; I offer thee up a sacrifice, O good Saoka,
made by Mazda and holy.
'Unto thee will I give in return a thousand brown oxen that
do not push; I offer thee up a sacrifice, O good Saoka, made by
Mazda and holy.
'Unto thee will I give in return a thousand females, big
with young, of all species of small cattle; I offer thee up a

'And I will bless thee with the fair blessing-spell of the

 IV.
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達，持阿沙的聖者，如此向汝言：『我阿胡拉‧馬茲達，一切美善之物的造主，當我造此宅舍時，美麗的、光輝的、遠處可見的（願我上升于彼處，願我抵達彼處！）
『其時那惡棍看著我；惡棍安格拉‧曼紐，致命的，對我作難，降九疾、九十疾、九百疾、九千疾、九倍萬疾。願汝治癒我，艾里亞曼啊，誓約的成就者啊！
『我將作為回報給予汝千匹駿馬，疾馳的馬；我向汝獻祭，美善的索卡啊，由馬茲達所作，至聖的。
『我將作為回報給予汝千匹駿駝，高峰的駝；我向汝獻祭，美善的索卡啊，由馬茲達所作，至聖的。
『我將作為回報給予汝千頭褐色的牛，不頂觸的牛；我向汝獻祭，美善的索卡啊，由馬茲達所作，至聖的。
『我將作為回報給予汝千頭懷崽的雌畜，一切小家畜之種族的；我向汝獻祭，美善的索卡啊，由馬茲達所作，至聖的。
『我將以正義者之美麗祝福咒、正義者之友善祝福咒來祝福汝，此咒使空者充滿，使滿者溢出，來助那衰患者，使患病者復歸健全。』

segments.orig:
moshu tat âs nôit darekhem ýat frâyatayat

segments.en:
Quickly was it done, nor was it long, eagerly set off the
vow-fulfilling Airyaman, towards the mountain of the holy
Questions, towards the forest of the holy Questions.
segments.zh: 迅速地完成了，不曾遲延，誓願實踐者艾里亞曼熱切地出發，朝向神聖提問之山，朝向神聖提問之森。

Nine kinds of stallions brought he with him, the
vow-fulfilling Airyaman.
Nine kinds of camels brought he with him, the vow-fulfilling
Airyaman.
Nine kinds of bulls brought he with him, the vow-fulfilling
Airyaman.
Nine kinds of small cattle brought he with him, the
vow-fulfilling Airyaman.
He brought with him the nine twigs; he drew along nine
furrows.
[21. 'I drive away Ishire and I drive away Aghuire; I drive away
Aghra and I drive away Ughra; I drive away sickness and I drive
away death; I drive away pain and I drive away fever; I drive
away Sarana and I drive away Sarastya; I drive away Azhana and I
drive away Azhahva; I drive away Kurugha and I drive away
Azhivaka; I drive away Duruka and I drive away Astairya. I drive
away the evil eye, rottenness, and infection which Angra Mainyu
has created against the bodies of mortals.
segments.zh:
履願的艾里亞曼帶來了九種種馬，
履願的艾里亞曼帶來了九種駱駝，
履願的艾里亞曼帶來了九種公牛，
履願的艾里亞曼帶來了九種小家畜。
他帶來了九根樹枝；他拖引了九道溝渠。
〔21. 「我驅趕伊希雷，我驅趕阿古伊雷；我驅趕阿格拉，我驅趕烏格拉；我驅趕疾病，我驅趕死亡；我驅趕疼痛，我驅趕高熱；我驅趕薩拉納，我驅趕薩拉斯提亞；我驅趕阿日納，我驅趕阿日哈瓦；我驅趕庫魯格拉，我驅趕阿日瓦卡；我驅趕杜魯卡，我驅趕阿斯塔伊里亞。我驅趕邪眼，腐爛，以及安格拉‧曼紐為了對付凡人的身體而創造的感染。〕

segments.en:
'I drive away all manner of sickness and death, all the
Yatus and Pairikas, and all the wicked Jainis.
' A Airyema Ishyo :-
May the vow-fulfilling Airyaman come here, for the men and
women of Zarathushtra to rejoice, for Vohu-mano to rejoice; with
the desirable reward that Religion deserves. I solicit for
holiness that boon that is vouchsafed by Ahura.
'May the vow-fulfilling Airyaman smite all manner of
sickness and death, all the Yatus and Pairikas, and all the
wicked Jainis.
' Yatha ahu vairyo :-
The will of the Lord is the law of
righteousness. The gifts of Vohu-mano to the deeds done in this
world for Mazda. He who relieves the poor makes Ahura king.
' Kem-na mazda :-
What protector hast thou given unto me O
Mazda! while the hate of the wicked encompasses me? Whom but
thy Atar and Vohu-mano, through whose work I keep on the world of
righteousness? Reveal therefore to me thy Religion as thy rule!
'Ke verethrem-ja:- Who is the victorious who will protect
thy teaching? Make it clear that I am the guide for both worlds. 
May Sraosha come with Vohu-mano and help whomsoever thou
pleasest, O Mazda!
'Keep us from our hater, O Mazda and Armaiti Spenta! Perish,
O fiendish Druj! Perish, O brood of the fiend! Perish, O world
of the fiend! Perish away, O Druj! Perish away to the regions of
the north, never more to give unto death the living world of
Righteousness!']
segments.zh:
我驅逐一切疾病和死亡，一切雅圖和佩里卡，以及一切邪惡的賈尼。
啊 艾里耶瑪‧伊什約：—
願誓願成就者艾里耶曼降臨此地，為查拉圖斯特拉的男人和女人歡喜，為沃胡‧曼諾歡喜；以宗教所應得的可欲報酬。我為聖性祈求那由阿胡拉所恩許的恩澤。
願誓願成就者艾里耶曼擊滅一切疾病和死亡，一切雅圖和佩里卡，以及一切邪惡的賈尼。
雅塔‧阿胡‧瓦依裡約：—
主的意志乃正義之法。沃胡‧曼諾的恩賜乃為馬茲達於此世所行之事。凡救濟貧苦者，使阿胡拉為王。
凱姆‧納‧馬茲達：—
啊馬茲達，汝賦予我何護者！當邪惡之仇恨環繞我時？除汝之阿塔爾和沃胡‧曼諾，我藉其功業得以持守正義之世界者外，又有誰乎？因此向我啟示汝之宗教為汝之統治！
凱‧瓦雷特雷姆賈：—誰乃勝者，將護衛汝之教導？明示我乃兩世界之引導者。願斯勞沙同沃胡‧曼諾降臨，助汝所悅者，啊馬茲達！
救護我們脫離仇恨者，啊馬茲達和斯彭塔‧阿爾邁提！惡德魯格滅亡！惡魔之種滅亡！惡魔之世界滅亡！德魯格遠去滅亡！遠去北方之地滅亡，永毋再將死亡賦予正義之生靈世界！
